verdict.rationale: PostHog's automation surfaces are Workflows (no-code triggers, delays, splits and message steps) and CDP Hog-function destinations, which have a built-in test interface, logs and editable code. The only explicit versioning is for Skills: every edit creates an immutable version with base_version concurrency checks, and scouts are skills, so agent-driven scouting automations are versioned. Review exists mainly for code changes, where Self-driving and the Slack agent open PRs for you to review and merge, but nothing documents versioning, change review or rollback for Workflows or destinations themselves. Missing for 10: version history and rollback for Workflows and CDP pipelines, an explicit rollback-to-previous-version capability for Skills, a review or approval flow for automation changes, and independent corroboration.
